response.sql: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), cross_pattern AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS avg_of_patterns FROM pattern_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, p.avg_acl_igg - c.avg_of_patterns AS above_cross_pattern_avg FROM pattern_averages AS p CROSS JOIN cross_pattern AS c WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > c.avg_of_patterns) SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg, above_cross_pattern_avg, avg_acl_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) FROM above_average) AS difference_from_above_average_patterns FROM above_average ORDER BY pattern;
